notes.title: Slender Threads – One Week Since Launch
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Today marks one week since the launch of Slender Threads, and we want to take a moment to thank you all for the incredible support we've received.

[h3]About the Launch Delay[/h3]
We know the game was delayed by two hours at launch, and we want to apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. Unfortunately, this was due to an issue with Steam's partner platform, which was out of our control. However, we understand that this may have affected some players' experiences. We wrote an article detailing what happened for those interested:
[url=https://medium.com/@ldebrasi/publicar-un-juego-a-pesar-de-steam-1a11b90fea92]Launching a Game Despite Steam[/url]

[h3]Game Reception[/h3]
Despite the hiccups, the response has been amazing! Slender Threads has been featured in outlets like Kotaku, PC Gamer, Rock Paper Shotgun, and many others. On top of that, we're thrilled to have a 96% positive rating from over 150 player reviews. Huge thanks to everyone who has taken the time to share their thoughts!

[h3]Slender Threads is Now Steam Deck Verified![/h3]
We're excited to announce that Slender Threads has been officially verified for Steam Deck, meaning you can enjoy the game on the go with a smooth experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36298238/42c0ef254bbdb65fa4435f5aaf7ce6675dbb3773.jpg[/img]

[h3]Your Reviews Make a Huge Difference[/h3]
If you've played Slender Threads and enjoyed it, please consider leaving a review on Steam. Every review helps tremendously in making the game more visible and allows us to continue creating new experiences for you.

Thanks again for being part of this journey. 

See you in the comments! 
Blyts Team

notes.title: Devlog March
notes.content:
Hi there!

Welcome to the first update of the year! We know it's been a while, but late 2022 was kind of boring news. We were mostly playtesting and polishing some details, which was time consuming.

So, back to Slender Threads, Playtesting made us rethink some things here and there. And although we love how the game is going, we wanted to add the cherry on top. So, here is what we've done since our last update:

- We have around 20 new scenes, going from the original 70 to 90.
- Added some cutscenes to build the atmosphere where needed.
- We are working on a new trailer to represent the actual game with its improvements.
- We are working on a playable epilogue (Just a little after-game experience to add a new point of view).

And here is what we have ahead:
- More playtesting
- Closing the script
- Voice recording
- Localization

Here's an advance from one of the new scenes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36298238/ca52788dfe1fab121e69867a74e11f0eea6d8e0a.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned.
See you in the next update!

notes.title: Devlog June
notes.content:
Hey there!

Let's shake the dust here... We know it's been a long since the last update, but we've used that time wisely.
We've reached that point where the news gets more interesting and have decided to keep you more updated on the game status. So, from now on, we'll try to make an update every month until the launch.

[h3]We are stepping into the final development stage. What does it mean?[/h3]
We have finished:
[list]
[*] All game scenes. Counting over 70, most of them are scrollable (Still can't believe that if we look back to our beginnings).
[*] Painting and animating more than 30 'living' characters.
[*] Almost every dialog line.
[/list]
[h3]What is missing, then?[/h3]
We have started the internal playtesting. Here we analyze the game flow and its difficulty, look for missing feedback, and polish dialogs. 
Once this is done. We'll start with the details, which is not a minor job and can be time consuming:
[list]
[*] Gestures: If you've had the opportunity to play the Prologue, you may have noticed that characters gesture according to the conversation.
[*] Making the town alive, with animations here and there.
[*] Music and sound effects.
[*] Voices (at this point, we have to be 100% sure the dialogs are final)
[*] Localization to over 8 languages.
[*] Optimization.
[*] Testing.
[*] Bug fixing.
[/list]
[h3]When is the game released?[/h3]
We'd love to have an answer for this. We are working really hard to have it ready by the end of this year, but at the same time don't want to create expectations around it.
The worst-case scenario is mid-2023.

We are also working on a few surprises to share in the following updates.
We know you've been very patient, and there are no words to express how thankful we feel about that. In exchange, we hope to deliver a  game worthy of it, and let us say that we are very proud of how Slender Threads is turning out.

[h3]What can you do meanwhile?[/h3]
If you played the Prologue, you could help us by leaving a comment. Each counts, and we truly appreciate hearing your thoughts!
If you haven't played the Prologue, it's free to play, so you may want to try it.
If you feel compulsive about sharing the game with your friends, please do so!
And of course, don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

See you in the next update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36298238/25953d695342ecd3bc70a43320ce68fd3b3b2ec2.gif[/img]

notes.title: Slender Threads: Prologue is out today!
notes.content:
Dear friends!

We are entering the last quarter of another crazy year and we hope you are all safe and doing well.
This 2021 was pretty much all about hard work and now it's time for a bit of fun. We are reaching to share the release of Slender Threads' Prologue.

Several years after we started our developing journey, we can say that we've grown as a team and are ready now to take on new challenges.
Making Slender Threads possible without crowdsourcing was a huge step. Being an Indie Studio based in South America is not easy. It sort of makes the road a little bumpier most of the time, but we found that facing obstacles makes us stronger and pushes our goals further.

If you enjoyed our adventures, Kelvin and the Infamous Machine or Nobodies, we hope this new game will be up to the task.

Slender Threads is a point-and-click thriller adventure with spreads of fun. We hope it'll make you jump off your chair and steal a good laugh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36298238/cbf13592241ae718b4cc4a6b41ace040b87607fd.jpg[/img]

[h3]About Slender Threads[/h3]

The moment he arrives in Villa Ventana, Harvey Green rolls his eyes. All he sees is one more lifeless town, no different from countless others he passes through as a traveling bookseller.
What Harvey is not seeing is that he has been called to Villa Ventana to play a part. Strings, pulled by some hidden presence, begin drawing him into a web of inevitability.
A recurring nightmare. Citizen disappearances. A chain of alluringly inexplicable events sets Harvey on a path toward a terrifying revelation about his own destiny.
Slender Threads explores the connections between disparate events and the extent to which we possess the agency to alter our fated course.

The prologue represents around 1 of the 8-10 hours of the full game. Featuring English voice acting, and Spanish, French, German, Italian subtitles.

If you love the idea and want to join us on this new adventure, there are two ways you can help us:
[list]
[*] Playing the Free Prologue and leaving us a review!
[*] Sharing it (tweets, emails, old classic phone calls are welcomed if they help to spread the news!)
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682490/Slender_Threads_Prologue/

Also, don't forget to add the full version to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116480/Slender_Threads/

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for giving us your time!

All things said.
Dare to follow the Slender Threads?

notes.title: Slender Threads: Quick Pitch
notes.content:
[b]Genre:[/b] Adventure / Point-and-Click / Psychological Thriller
[b]Audience:[/b] 17 + / Players who enjoy story-driven games
[b]Play Time:[/b] Approximately 15 hours
[b]Estimated Launch Date:[/b] Q2 2021
[b]Targeted Platforms:[/b] PC (Steam, GOG) / Nintendo Switch / iOS / Android
[b]Supported Languages:[/b] English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Russian

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36298238/ee78113b1e63b8c2008d9fed8f4d6b80bad76b93.png[/img]

[h3]Plot[/h3]
The moment he arrives in Villa Ventana, Harvey Green rolls his eyes.

All he sees is one more lifeless town, no different from countless others he passes through as a traveling bookseller.

What Harvey doesn’t see is that he has been called to Villa Ventana to play a part. Strings, pulled by some hidden presence, begin drawing him into a web of inevitability.

A recurring nightmare. Citizen disappearances. A chain of alluringly inexplicable events sets Harvey on a path toward a terrifying revelation about his own destiny.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36298238/5d918743fca727dbd697032b693d05f23b824bf5.jpg[/img]


Harvey’s actions can change how the story unfolds...to an extent. Different choices lead to different interactions, and to different confrontations. But can any of these choices alter the ultimate outcome for Harvey, or for anyone?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36298238/3e2e0b5da0652bc2bab1fc2db9327dcc561bc2ef.jpg[/img]


Slender Threads depicts two-dimensional characters and objects in a three-dimensional environment to mimic the appearance of cutouts in a diorama. 
Each asset is meticulously hand-drawn to enhance this effect. We want the game to feel like playing a living storybook.
